svg.title: A tent pulse 2 mm high at 10 cm from a guitar bridge and its flipped mirror image beyond the bridge, at 0, 0.70 and 1.40 ms; the real string is solid, the mirror dashed; drawn to scale across, 6.5 px per cm, and 12 px per mm up
svg.text: t = 0 ms: let go from rest
t = 0.70 ms: the halves meet at the bridge
t = 1.40 ms: the echo is back, flipped
x, cm from the bridge (left of 0: the mirror, not real string)
